issues.description: The page is showing 'STEP 1 OF 4' but this is step-2 (URL: /design/step-2). The progress indicator is wrong.
issues.root_cause: The step counter in apps/web/app/design/step-2/page.tsx is hardcoded or incorrectly set to 'STEP 1 OF 4' instead of 'STEP 2 OF 4'.

issues.description: After selecting a room type, the page should transition to showing a 2x2 grid of 4 style images for anchor question 1 of 3. No such transition appears to be happening — the page is stuck showing only the room type selection without any ability to proceed to style images.
issues.element: Style image grid (2x2) for anchor question phase
issues.root_cause: The page may be missing state management to transition from room selection to style image selection, or the anchor question component is not rendered after a room is selected. The onClick handler on room buttons may not update state to show the next phase.

issues.description: Images from Supabase storage for the style anchor questions are not loading/visible at all — the phase that shows them is never reached.
issues.root_cause: Since the room selection phase never transitions to the style image phase, the Supabase image loading code is never executed. The root cause is the missing or broken state transition logic in the page component.
